description: Has this business had environmental violations or enforcement in Texas? Returns its TCEQ (Texas Commission on Environmental Quality) customer records with TCEQ's compliance-history classification, a summary (notices of violation and enforcement, complaints, administrative orders, civil judgments, penalties in USD), and dated events, newest first. Texas only; businesses registered with the Texas Comptroller or TABC, refreshed nightly from Texas state datasets. TCEQ records carry no taxpayer number, so each customer link and each event carries a confidence and how it was attributed. Complaints are allegations, not findings. Requires a signed-in caller (token or OAuth). Example: {"entity_id": "32057926266", "include_affiliates": true}.

entity_id.description: entity_id from resolve_business (11-digit Texas taxpayer number), or a 10-digit SOS file number.

include_affiliates.description: Also include affiliated entities (likely common control, confidence >= 0.5). Default false.

since.description: Only events on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: get_environmental_record
title: Environmental compliance of a Texas business
